$comment: The one closed registry of reason and refusal codes (O6/O7 r2.3 §5.4, §5.5). Closed per release: a verifier refuses a name not listed. Lanes add entries by a reviewed change to this file. Host codes come from the host design's r2 and are local (no HTTP status).

reasons.name: bad_form
reasons.meaning: a header, body or signed object isn't in its exact form

reasons.name: bad_audience
reasons.meaning: aud isn't this service

reasons.name: clock_skew
reasons.meaning: outside the 5-minute window; carries the service's time

reasons.name: bad_signature
reasons.meaning: the signature doesn't verify, or the type isn't signed by that kind of signer

reasons.name: unknown_host
reasons.meaning: not paired, or a re-paired host's old id

reasons.name: host_revoked
reasons.meaning: the host is revoked

reasons.name: agent_revoked
reasons.meaning: the agent is revoked

reasons.name: stale_generation
reasons.meaning: gen isn't the current generation; a retry under a newer one carries only receipt_state

reasons.name: grant_expired
reasons.meaning: the grant's not_after_ms has passed

reasons.name: replay
reasons.meaning: the nonce has been seen

reasons.name: idem_mismatch
reasons.meaning: the same idem with a different operation digest

reasons.name: cap_invalid
reasons.meaning: the capability is unknown, expired, replaced or bound elsewhere

reasons.name: not_granted
reasons.meaning: the operation or agent isn't in the grant

reasons.name: scope
reasons.meaning: the endpoint's path scope (its existing code)

reasons.name: not_found
reasons.meaning: a missing path, and any path in /.agents the caller can't read (O4)

reasons.name: limit
reasons.meaning: a size or count limit; carries which

reasons.name: device_unknown
reasons.meaning: the signer isn't enrolled at chain_seq, or its signer kind isn't the type's

reasons.name: chain_fork
reasons.meaning: two entries at one seq, or a chain behind the pin (rollback)

reasons.name: approval_used
reasons.meaning: an approval used twice

reasons.name: approval_mismatch
reasons.meaning: subject_hash, kind or requester doesn't match the operation, or a preimage doesn't match its hash

reasons.name: stale_auth
reasons.meaning: the sign-in is more than 5 minutes old, for a change of the fleet's shape

reasons.name: unauthenticated
reasons.meaning: no live account session, or a relay token that is missing, unknown, used or expired (one code, no hint which)

reasons.name: rate
reasons.meaning: a rate limit; carries retry_after_s

reasons.name: in_progress
reasons.meaning: the same idem is pending; carries retry_after_s

reasons.name: outcome_unknown
reasons.meaning: the first attempt's outcome is being reconciled

reasons.name: idem_expired
reasons.meaning: op is more than 23 hours old, or in the future

reasons.name: approval_stale
reasons.meaning: the approval's gen or life is no longer current

reasons.name: device_tier
reasons.meaning: a browser device signed what needs a native signer

reasons.name: device_removed
reasons.meaning: the signer was removed at the verifier's pinned head

reasons.name: browser_gen_stale
reasons.meaning: a retired or stale browser_gen

reasons.name: recovery_key_mismatch
reasons.meaning: a recover entry not signed by the chain's recovery key

reasons.name: package_stale
reasons.meaning: a sealed package expired, already opened, revoked, or of another generation

reasons.name: preflight_missing
reasons.meaning: a required unit, Landlock or path-contract control is missing at start

reasons.name: landlock_abi
reasons.meaning: the kernel's Landlock ABI is below 4

reasons.name: unit_failed
reasons.meaning: the agent's unit failed or exited while starting; it is left stopped and masked until the next grant or a resume

reasons.name: start_timeout
reasons.meaning: the agent's start didn't finish within its deadline; it is left stopped and masked until the next grant or a resume

reasons.name: uid_exhausted
reasons.meaning: the host's agent UID range is used up (UIDs are never reused)

reasons.name: clone_detected
reasons.meaning: the host keys don't match this machine id; re-pair

reasons.name: qualify_required
reasons.meaning: the qualification report is missing, or invalidated by a change

reasons.name: audit_unavailable
reasons.meaning: a durable intent couldn't be appended (unavailable); refused fail-closed

reasons.name: audit_timeout
reasons.meaning: a durable intent couldn't be appended (timeout); refused fail-closed

reasons.name: audit_full
reasons.meaning: a durable intent couldn't be appended (full); refused fail-closed

reasons.name: profile_identity
reasons.meaning: a profile directory or one of its session mountpoints differs from its record; the turn didn't run, and the profile is quarantined for repair

reasons.name: turn_preflight
reasons.meaning: a turn failed before the CLI exec, at its unit, namespace, turn file, session store, stdio, setid, capability drop, no_new_privs, Landlock, filter or exec step, as a complete failure record proves; nothing ran

reasons.name: no_profile
reasons.meaning: no bound profile of the harness is in the agent's pool

reasons.name: all_blocked
reasons.meaning: every candidate profile is rate-limited until its reset

reasons.name: busy
reasons.meaning: the conversation already has an active turn, or a lease bound is reached

reasons.name: agent_fenced
reasons.meaning: the agent is fenced, so no turn is admitted

reasons.name: source_unavailable
reasons.meaning: the profile a pinned (none-continuity) conversation needs is gone

reasons.name: program_mismatch
reasons.meaning: the rewrite program's bytes aren't the reviewed, pinned program

reasons.name: unknown_owner
reasons.meaning: no rewrite program for this CDP result or event

reasons.name: unmappable
reasons.meaning: a CDP result or event isn't the shape the rewrite program expects; it's dropped, never forwarded

reasons.name: bad_kind
reasons.meaning: not a virtual handle kind

reasons.name: stale_handle
reasons.meaning: a virtual handle that's revoked, unknown, of another kind or from another target

reasons.name: bad_scope
reasons.meaning: a target-local handle without its target's scope, or a page handle with one

reasons.name: handle_budget
reasons.meaning: the session has allocated its whole handle budget (live and revoked); it's retired

reasons.name: bad_params
reasons.meaning: an agent's CDP command parameters are missing, extra, of the wrong type or out of their bounds
